visualCharacteristics.purpose: Form built from a JSON field definition (spreadsheet), with client-side validation and JSON POST submission
visualCharacteristics.layout: Bordered, rounded panel holding a single-column grid of fields; buttons are centred in a row at the bottom, followed by a polite live status message.
behavior: Lazily fetches the form definition when the block scrolls into view.
The first link in the block is the form definition (JSON with `data` or `fields` array); the optional second link is the submit endpoint.

Field types: text and other input types, textarea, select (comma-separated options or an options URL), radio, checkbox, toggle, submit, reset, and confirmation (a same-origin thank-you path shown as a fragment on success).
Field properties: field, label, type, required, default, placeholder, help, options, conditional.
If the definition cannot be loaded, the block's section wrapper is removed.

contentPattern.structure: one cell with a link to the form definition JSON, optionally followed by a link to the submit endpoint
notes: Without a submit link the form renders but does not submit.
Status messages (Sending..., Thanks!, error) are currently fixed in the block code.

usage: Use for newsletter sign-up, contact and similar forms. Create a form definition sheet (for example an email field plus a SIGN UP submit) and link it from the block.
reuseGuidance: Has no options. Change fields in the definition sheet, not in the block.
